name: The True Tale
source:
Dear Mortal.

Welcome to The True Tale, when the time has stopped, colors have erased and everyone went insane.
It's just how they're describing this world.
But I promise you will have fun, and this game will learn you that I am expert at keeping promises!

Sincerely,
Shiminiku
translation:
亲爱的凡人：

欢迎来到《The True Tale》。在这里，时间停止了，色彩消失了，所有人都疯了。至少，大家都是这么形容这个世界的。
但我保证你会玩得很开心，而且这款游戏会让你知道，我最擅长的就是信守承诺！

谨上，
Shiminiku
